LanguageData.LP_DT_Orderly.stages.0.label: well-ordered
LanguageData.LP_DT_Orderly.stages.0.description: Someone is in charge of the colony and the rules hold.
LanguageData.LP_DT_NoSchedule.stages.0.label: no order at all
LanguageData.LP_DT_NoSchedule.stages.0.description: No fixed time to work or sleep. This can't go on.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Restrained.stages.0.label: restrained
LanguageData.LP_DT_Restrained.stages.0.description: Being ordered around in a draft nonstop; I can't take it anymore.
LanguageData.LP_DT_UndeadUnease.stages.0.label: blasphemous creations
LanguageData.LP_DT_UndeadUnease.stages.0.description: The forcibly awakened dead walk among the colony. This isn't right.
LanguageData.LP_DT_DarkShelter.stages.0.label: dark protection
LanguageData.LP_DT_DarkShelter.stages.0.description: With a lich holding the fort, nobody dares touch us.
LanguageData.LP_DT_DragonDread.stages.0.label: dragon's dread
LanguageData.LP_DT_DragonDread.stages.0.description: There's a dragon nearby. My hands won't stop shaking.
LanguageData.LP_DT_LichDevotee.stages.0.label: serving the undying
LanguageData.LP_DT_LichDevotee.stages.0.description: The colony has a lich. Serving an undying one is my honor.
LanguageData.LP_DT_UndeadAbhor.stages.0.label: living with the undead
LanguageData.LP_DT_UndeadAbhor.stages.0.description: I swore to give the dead rest, and now I live with them.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.0.label: many peoples together
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.0.description: The colony has all kinds of people. So lively.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.1.label: many peoples together
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.1.description: The colony has all kinds of people. So lively.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.2.label: many peoples together
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.2.description: The colony has all kinds of people. So lively.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.3.label: many peoples together
LanguageData.LP_DT_Cosmopolitan.stages.3.description: The colony has all kinds of people. So lively.
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureMajority.stages.0.label: my people in charge
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureMajority.stages.0.description: Most of the colony are my own people. That's reassuring.
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureMajority.stages.1.label: surrounded by strangers
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureMajority.stages.1.description: The colony is full of outsiders.
LanguageData.LP_DT_FlayerNear.stages.0.label: memories of the colony
LanguageData.LP_DT_FlayerNear.stages.0.description: There's a mind flayer nearby. I can smell the colony again.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Outdoors.stages.0.label: between earth and sky
LanguageData.LP_DT_Outdoors.stages.0.description: Wind on my face, earth under my feet. This is living.
LanguageData.LP_DT_ArcaneCraving.stages.0.label: arcane craving
LanguageData.LP_DT_ArcaneCraving.stages.0.description: Haven't touched a magic potion or scroll for days. I miss that feeling.
LanguageData.LP_DT_GoodDeed.stages.0.label: good deed
LanguageData.LP_DT_GoodDeed.stages.0.description: I helped someone who needed help.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Mercy.stages.0.label: showed mercy
LanguageData.LP_DT_Mercy.stages.0.description: I beat the enemy down, but spared {PAWN_possessive} life.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Conscience.stages.0.label: guilty conscience
LanguageData.LP_DT_Conscience.stages.0.description: What we did to that person... I can't sleep.
LanguageData.LP_DT_Dragonslain.stages.0.label: slew the dragon
LanguageData.LP_DT_Dragonslain.stages.0.description: That dragon has fallen. My oath is fulfilled.
LanguageData.LP_DT_UnwantedBuff.stages.0.label: ensorcelled
LanguageData.LP_DT_UnwantedBuff.stages.0.description: Someone cast a spell on me. I don't like it, even if it was "for my own good".
LanguageData.LP_DT_ArcaneFix.stages.0.label: arcane nourished
LanguageData.LP_DT_ArcaneFix.stages.0.description: Magic flowing through the whole body; it feels so good.
LanguageData.LP_DT_CallOfAdventure.stages.0.label: call of adventure
LanguageData.LP_DT_CallOfAdventure.stages.0.descripti: The treasure is right there waiting for me!
LanguageData.LP_DT_FarWhisper.stages.0.label: far-realm whispers
LanguageData.LP_DT_FarWhisper.stages.0.description: That person kept muttering something just now. It sent chills down my spine.
LanguageData.LP_DT_GiantDevotion.stages.0.label: giant's servant
LanguageData.LP_DT_GiantHatred.stages.0.label: giant slayer
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureBlood.stages.0.label: same kind
LanguageData.LP_DT_PureBlood.stages.1.label: other kind
LanguageData.LP_DT_GithKinship.stages.0.label: nemesis of the colony
LanguageData.LP_DT_ExileLich.stages.0.label: the forsaken queen
LanguageData.LP_DT_MagicDistrust.stages.0.label: spellcaster
